name: Suzuki Diva
source:
A zombie girl with an unconventional name, she has an easygoing, natural, and leisurely personality.

She has a natural talent for songwriting, but her singing and dancing are so mediocre that no matter how hard she tries, she can't rise above the average level. She has an innocence that maintains her attitude no matter who she's with, and she is worryingly honest. She is half-Japanese and has a love for Japan's HENTAI ANIME.

By the way, when she became a zombie, her body turned into silicon for some reason.

[translated from [url=http://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/hakata_dz/index.html]official website[/url]]
